kind: papyrus (two related texts: recto loan contract; verso cargo valuation)
notes: HGV: Mitte II (low precision); provenance unknown. Recto: loan for a Muziris voyage; borrower bears camel, desert freight (phoretron), Nile freight until the tetarte; creditor may collect the tetarte and dispose of the three parts on default. No interest rate preserved in the surviving text. Verso: valuation of the Hermapollon cargo.
Loci used: 6.101-104; 12.84; edition not identified by Nappo for Latin text
